description: This file defines platform-specific functions for verifying and performing firmware upgrades in an OpenWRT environment, including a placeholder check and an upgrade procedure.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function that checks the integrity or validity of a firmware image; currently always returns success.
